platform_boundaries.application_responsibility: consume public OCP session and identity contracts; never create a parallel identity system
retain framework CSRF protection on writes and justify every read-only exemption
enforce actor, target scope and concrete capability server-side with deny-by-default semantics
own data, retention decisions, provider projection, validation, logging minimization and app-local audit
declare compatible platform range and avoid embedding environment assumptions

external_services: Nextcloud and its public OCP APIs
configured LDAP or other Nextcloud user backends
OpenHolidays API through the single LocalBase adapter
Google Calendar OAuth/API where explicitly configured
GitHub Actions and referenced build actions
out_of_scope: Nextcloud core implementation and infrastructure hardening
operating system, database, reverse proxy, backup and identity-provider operation
WordPress legacy runtime and legacy data import
formal BSI certification and external penetration testing

support_policy.source_for_platform_versions: each appinfo/info.xml plus reproducible future-compatibility evidence
